objective: Proof with machine check: a start whose live knots come in partner pairs, every knot a candidate with all but its partner, blocks the candidate pairs and open counts 2^(n-1), keeps that form at every round, with N(t+1) = 2^(N(t)/2) - N(t-1); it never closes, and its counts outrun every cluster reading on a finite complex.
title: Paired starts grow forever, faster than any cluster reading
